description: US business bankruptcy cases filed in a date range (dateFiled). Individual debtors and adversary proceedings (lawsuits) are omitted unless include_individuals or include_adversary is true. Omitting both dates defaults to yesterday. start_date and end_date are inclusive calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD), including filings later that day. Case numbers are shortCaseNumber. total is the full match count, not the page size. limit is one page (max 500, default 100); pass skip or offset for the next page. has_more is true when more rows remain. Paid.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive through the end of that calendar day.

include_individuals.description: Include individual debtors. Default false (business filings only).

limit.description: Max rows in this page (1-500). Default 100. total is the full match count.

skip.description: Rows to skip. Alias: offset. skip wins when both are set.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive of that whole calendar day.

name: get_cases_by_date_range_tool
